name: Melody
source:
Melody the deuteragonist of the story. She's a sickly half-vampire who's obsessed with the idea that she lost something or somebody took it from her. She easily forgets about everything and has false memories.
Melody is a fan of the Belle Epoque era and likes making utensils inspired by it. She lives in Cat Island, Castillia.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/witchnovel88/status/1538193685074042880/photo/1]Twitter[/url]]
